# Darwin Iquiña | Video Editor

## About

Darwin is a video editor who cuts short vertical videos. Services: high-retention reels and shorts, UGC and product ads (Darwin directs the whole video, not only the edit), captions and sound design, podcast and long-form repurposing, coaching and educational content, and custom editing and creative direction.
